page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r8ae.large is a memory-optimized virtual machine provisioned on the KVM hypervisor. It is powered by an AMD EPYC 9T34 processor operating at a base frequency of 3.4 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The instance configuration allocates 2 dedicated vCPUs mapped across a single physical core with multithreading enabled. The CPU includes 32 KB of L1 data cache, 1.0 MB of L2 cache, and 32 MB of shared L3 cache, with hardware support for AVX-512 vector extensions including AVX-512 VNNI and BF16. System memory totals 16.0 GB, providing an 8.0 GB per vCPU allocation ratio. The instance does not include integrated local storage and operates with a baseline network bandwidth of 3 Gbps without hardware GPU acceleration.

Benchmark evaluation shows strong single-core CPU metrics, ranking in the top 10% on stress-ng single-core tests (3111.99) and the top 25% in Geekbench single-core execution (1962.0). Conversely, aggregate parallel compute performance is limited by the single physical core layout, resulting in lower-quartile multi-core scores in both Geekbench (2448.0) and stress-ng (3112.6). Uncached memory bandwidth tests demonstrate moderate sustained performance, reaching 45.05 GB/sec for large block reads and 26.33 GB/sec for writes. Performance on highly concurrent tasks reflects the limited core count, evidenced by 999.29 operations in PassMark database testing and 2.85 GB/sec in static web serving benchmarks.

In terms of resource allocation efficiency, the instance provides access to modern AMD EPYC architecture and a generous memory-to-vCPU ratio on an entry-level compute footprint. Because compute scaling is constrained to two threads on one core and local NVMe is omitted, it is not structured for heavy parallel processing or high-IOPS local database storage. The instance profile aligns with lightweight in-memory caching layers, single-threaded processing services, moderate background worker tasks, and development environments requiring higher memory availability relative to compute capacity.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r8ae.large is a memory-optimized virtual instance equipped with 2 dedicated vCPUs, 1 physical AMD EPYC 9T34 core, and 16.0 GB of RAM on an x86_64 architecture. Clocked at 3.4 GHz, the CPU includes 32 MB of L3 cache alongside AVX-512 vector extensions. The instance provisions no integrated local storage, relying on remote block storage, and includes a 3 Gbps baseline network bandwidth without GPU accelerators. Benchmark evaluation exhibits strong single-threaded CPU execution, placing in the top tiers of Geekbench and stress-ng tests. Conversely, multi-threaded scaling remains constrained due to the 2-vCPU hardware footprint, leading to lower-percentile parallel throughput and database operation scores. Memory bandwidth delivers steady average throughput for large block transactions. This profile makes ecs.r8ae.large suitable for memory-dependent tasks that rely on single-threaded execution, lightweight in-memory caching layers, and small background worker processes.
